name: Voyager — PostgreSQL → YugabyteDB live migration
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq postgresql-client && chmod +x init-voyager-postgres/prompt-import.sh init-voyager-postgres/prompt-wa.sh init-voyager-postgres/pre-step.sh && sudo chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null || true && sudo install -m 755 .devcontainer/scripts/yb-voyager-wrapper.sh /usr/local/bin/yb-voyager && docker-compose -f init-voyager-postgres/compose.yml pull && docker pull --platform linux/amd64 yugabytedb/yb-voyager:latest && curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lerocha/chinook-database/master/ChinookDatabase/DataSources/Chinook_PostgreSql.sql -o init-voyager-postgres/chinook_data.sql && mkdir -p /workspaces/ybdb-vanguard/voyager-data /workspaces/ybdb-vanguard/ybdb/backup && echo "✅ PostgreSQL Voyager exercise ready"'
postStartCommand: bash -c 'bash .devcontainer/scripts/start-ybdb.sh 1 && sudo chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null || true && docker-compose -f init-voyager-postgres/compose.yml up -d && echo "" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → psql                (PostgreSQL source shell)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → yb-voyager-export   (Voyager export shell)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → yb-voyager-import   (Voyager import shell)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → yb-voyager-wa       (Voyager cutover shell)"'

tasks.label: postgres-live-ws
tasks.detail: Workshop shell for manual PostgreSQL live migration commands — yb-voyager, ysqlsh (init-voyager-postgres)
tasks.command: cd init-voyager-postgres && echo '🐘 postgres-live-ws  —  Workshop shell' && echo '   Run manual yb-voyager commands here' && exec bash

tasks.label: postgres-live-demo
tasks.detail: "Zero-Downtime Live Migration" — snapshot + CDC streaming, cutover (init-voyager-postgres/prompt.sh)
tasks.command: cd init-voyager-postgres && echo '═══ Zero-Downtime Live Migration: PostgreSQL → YugabyteDB ═══' && echo '' && echo '  1. psql shell          → bash pre-step.sh           (verify source)' && echo '  2. yb-voyager-export   → bash prompt.sh              (Steps 0-2 + Step 4)' && echo '  3. yb-voyager-import   → bash prompt-import.sh       (Step 3 + Step 5)' && echo '  4. yb-voyager-wa       → bash prompt-wa.sh           (Steps 6-11)' && echo '' && exec bash

//: PGUSER / PGPASSWORD are set by the devcontainer env; -h overrides PGHOST so
this task always reaches the postgres container, never YugabyteDB.
tasks.label: psql
tasks.detail: Open a psql session against the source PostgreSQL database (init-voyager-postgres)
tasks.command: cd init-voyager-postgres && echo '🐘 psql  (Pre-step → show source data)' && echo '' && echo '   Run: bash pre-step.sh' && echo '   Or connect directly: psql -h postgres' && echo '' && until (echo >/dev/tcp/postgres/5432) 2>/dev/null; do echo 'Waiting for PostgreSQL...'; sleep 3; done && echo 'PostgreSQL ready.' && exec bash

tasks.label: yb-voyager-export
tasks.detail: Open the Voyager export shell (assess / export schema + data) (init-voyager-postgres)
tasks.command: cd init-voyager-postgres && echo '📤 yb-voyager-export  (Steps 0–2 → assess, export schema, analyze)' && echo '   then Step 4 → export data from source (runs until cutover)' && echo '' && echo '   Run: bash prompt.sh' && exec bash

tasks.label: yb-voyager-import
tasks.detail: Open the Voyager import shell (import schema + data) (init-voyager-postgres)
tasks.command: cd init-voyager-postgres && echo '📥 yb-voyager-import  (Step 3 → import schema; Step 5 → import data to target)' && echo '   Run Step 3 after Steps 0–2 complete in yb-voyager-export shell.' && echo '' && echo '   Run: bash prompt-import.sh' && exec bash

tasks.label: yb-voyager-wa
tasks.detail: Open the Voyager cutover shell (migration report / cutover / end migration) (init-voyager-postgres)
tasks.command: cd init-voyager-postgres && echo '✂️  yb-voyager-wa  (Steps 6–11 → report, cutover, finalize, archive, end, verify)' && echo '   Run after Steps 4+5 are streaming in export/import shells.' && echo '' && echo '   Run: bash prompt-wa.sh' && exec bash
